propositions: A gateway/* provider (gateway/anthropic, gateway/bedrock, gateway/google-cloud, gateway/groq, gateway/openai) with no base_url is incorrectly stamped tier=first_class instead of best_effort.
The tier derivation in capabilities.py checks only base_url presence and ignores that gateway providers are opaque intermediaries that can rewrite requests.
Signed verdicts with tier=first_class from gateway providers misrepresent provenance to attestation consumers who rely on tier to assess trust.
Direct providers without base_url must continue to stamp tier=first_class; the fix must not collaterally break existing behavior.
endpoint_host should remain None for gateway providers unless base_url is explicitly configured, to report only configured values rather than synthesized ones.
